doc.title: Ray Bauduc and Nappy Lamare Interview, 1959-09-09

title: Playing together at Spanish Fort; Nappy's first band, the Owls
summary: Ray and Nappy first played together out at Spanish Fort with Johnny Bayersdorffer. Nappy's first band was the New Orleans Owls, and he is on a few of their records.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: When did you all ever play together for the first time? Not until the Crosby Band? You must have played down there.
No, we used to play out at Spanish Ford, Nappy and I played with Johnny Bison. Come on, get it here, man. That's right, I forgot. I forgot about that.
Sure, he used to play out at Spanish Ford, Tokyo Gardens. My first band was the Owls, New Orleans Owls.
Oh, the Owls, sure. Yeah. Did you make any of the records with them? Yeah, I made... You're on those records, then?
Well, a couple of them. Some of them, yeah. Yeah.
